title: Questions, <gradient>answered.</gradient>
lede: Everything you need to know about how ClutchD works before you book.

items.question: How does ClutchD matching work?
items.answer: ClutchD finds verified nearby providers for your request, and you can track the match in real time.

items.question: How do estimates and pricing work?
items.answer: You see the price before work starts and approve the estimate before the wrench lifts.

items.question: How are providers verified?
items.answer: Every mechanic and garage passes identity and skill verification (KYC) before joining the network.

items.question: Where is ClutchD available?
items.answer: Currently rolling out in Coimbatore, with more cities planned.

items.question: What payment methods are supported?
items.answer: Pay securely through the platform with Stripe and Razorpay.

items.question: What does "Preview" mean?
items.answer: Some screens and figures on this page are illustrative previews of the product; real numbers update as ClutchD rolls out.

items.question: How much does a job cost?
items.answer: Every job shows a full estimate — labour and parts — before work starts. You approve before the wrench lifts, then pay securely in-platform via Stripe or Razorpay.

items.question: Which areas are serviced?
items.answer: ClutchD runs in Coimbatore today and opens in more Tamil Nadu cities as the pilot proves each stage. Join early access and we'll tell you when your city opens.

items.question: What happens to my data?
items.answer: Early-access emails are used only for launch announcements, and site analytics run cookie-free with no personal data. See the Privacy Policy for the full detail.

items.question: Can I trust a mechanic I've never met?
items.answer: Every provider passes identity and skill verification (KYC) before joining. You see the estimate before they arrive, track them live on the map, and pay in-platform with a receipt.

items.question: I'm a mechanic. How do I join?
items.answer: Sign up for early access and complete KYC identity and skill verification. Once verified, jobs come to you directly — manage your availability and build ratings that bring more customers.

items.question: Can I cancel a request?
items.answer: Yes. Cancel before a mechanic accepts and there's no charge. Every request, including cancelled ones, shows up in your service history.
